patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with stark black or white backgrounds, often featuring oversized typography or immersive media content.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif typography is used as primary visual elements and section titles, contrasting with smaller, regular-weight sans-serif text for body copy and uppercase labels.

A high-contrast black and white base palette is punctuated by vibrant, almost neon, accent colors (pink, blue, cyan, green) used sparingly for underlines, small graphic elements, or subtle highlights.

Large typographic elements and background media scroll with a distinct parallax effect, appearing to move slower than the foreground content, while new content sections reveal themselves with a subtle slide-up or fade-in as they enter the viewport.
Sections are frequently introduced by a single, massive typographic statement that acts as a visual anchor or divider, often spanning the full width of the viewport.

technique_notes: A sticky header remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining navigation access. Large background elements and oversized text blocks are implemented with a scroll-based parallax effect, making them appear to move at a different speed than the main content. Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, such as a subtle fade-up or slide-in, as they become visible within the viewport. The overall smooth scrolling experience is enhanced by a library like locomotive-scroll, while dynamic content like carousels or galleries might leverage swiper for interactive elements.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-6x body) dominate the page as visual elements, complemented by smaller, regular-weight sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, particularly around large typographic elements and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness and visual impact.

standout: The site's distinctive use of monumental, bold typography as both primary visual elements and structural section breaks, combined with a high-contrast black and white palette accented by unexpected neon colors, creates a powerful and editorial aesthetic that feels more like an art installation than a typical agency website.
